notes.title: Bug Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug fixes
- Fixed max enemy spawn cap adjustment issue
- Implement invincible for 5s after revival
- Fixed curse value cause abnormal enemies move speed
- Fixed enemy have abnormal damage when game without curse
- Boss will not be affected by certain debuff such as bleeding and sleep
- Fixed EXP display in training room unable to be pick up

Feature update
- Implement enemy collision enablement in shop

notes.title: Balance update
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
- Fixed upgrade panel becomes inaccessible after weapons and items reach max level
- Fixed pause when level up will cause the upgrade panel won't show up
- Various text corrections
- Fixed Qiuqiu weapon damage display in result scene
- Fixed Steam achievement link

Balance update:
- Komaru skill increased full‑HP healing effect
- Bike state after Uni’s skill now deals damage when colliding with enemies
- Chako’s skill reduced gold‑bonus damage
- Increase damage for all other characters’ skill
- Strengthened member card effect
- Set spawn cap limit to avoid hard to complete the game in high curse level
- Buff projectile weapons
- Storm robot will take 50% damage even rebound projectile weapons
- Weakened aura weapons

New feature
- Shop added option to close Gforce enhancement
- Implement adjustable max enemy spawn cap per minutes which available after complete the level

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.content:
- Graphic bug fix for certain ulti when burn debuff add to player
- Enemy count check to avoid bug for missing enemy (unknow root cause hence precaution is made)
- Fix easter egg is not function for certain weapon
- Remove tree and setting button in training room
- Fix exit button for pause screen in training room
- Reduce number of enemy to build the wall event so player can walk through the gape
- Weapon balancing update
